dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, look at this photo! I posted it this morning.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈlʊk ət ðɪs ˈfoʊtoʊ! aɪ ˈpoʊstɪd ɪt ðɪs ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Wow, it's beautiful! And look at all the comments!
dialogue.reading: ˈwaʊ, ɪts ˈbjuːtəfəl! ənd ˈlʊk ət ˈɔːl ðə ˈkɑːmɛnts!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I know! I'm chatting with my friends about it now.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ! aɪm ˈtʃætɪŋ wɪð maɪ ˈfrɛndz əˈbaʊt ɪt ˈnaʊ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: My profile photo is very old. I'm worried about it.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈproʊfaɪl ˌfoʊtoʊ ɪz ˈvɛri ˈoʊld. aɪm ˈwɜːrid əˈbaʊt ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Don't worry about it. Let's take a new photo now!
dialogue.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈwɜːri əˈbaʊt ɪt. ˈlɛts ˈteɪk ə ˈnuː ˈfoʊtoʊ ˈnaʊ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK! Here's the new one. What do you think?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ! hɪrz ðə ˈnuː ˈwʌn. ˈwʌt duː juː ˈθɪŋk?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: It's great! Post it, and I'll write the first comment.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈɡreɪt! ˈpoʊst ɪt, ənd aɪl ˈraɪt ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈkɑːmɛnt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks! And I'll reply to your comment.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks! ənd aɪl rɪˈplaɪ tə jʊr ˈkɑːmɛnt.
